title: Event Sourcing Timelines
description: Builds timelines from event-sourced logs where every state change is an event. Scrubbing replays events to any point; the timeline is the log made visible. Time travel is a replay.

demo.title: Demo — Event Sourcing Timelines

title: Scrubber UI Design
description: Designs scrubber controls with the right feel: inertia, snapping, precision modes. The scrubber is the primary instrument; its feel decides usability. Video editors set the standard.

demo.title: Demo — Scrubber UI Design

title: Temporal Databases
description: Queries history with bitemporal tables tracking valid time and transaction time. 'What did we know when' becomes answerable; scrubbing is a query. It is the database of record for regulated data.

demo.title: Demo — Temporal Databases

title: Time-Travel Queries
description: Runs AS OF queries against versioned data for instant historical views. The storage keeps versions; the query picks the time. Debugging 'what changed' becomes trivial.

demo.title: Demo — Time-Travel Queries

title: Video Scrubbing Tech
description: Decodes video frames on scrub with keyframe indexes and predictive caching. Scrubbing backward is hard for codecs; the tech prefetches and caches smartly. Smooth scrub is engineering, not luck.

demo.title: Demo — Video Scrubbing Tech

title: Log Timeline Correlation
description: Correlates logs from many systems onto one timeline with clock discipline. NTP-synced timestamps align events; the merged timeline tells the incident story. Scrubbing finds the moment everything changed.

demo.title: Demo — Log Timeline Correlation

title: Playback Controls
description: Builds playback controls: play, step, speed, loop for temporal data. Stepping frame by frame reveals what playing hides; speeds compress long periods. Controls match the data's nature.

demo.title: Demo — Playback Controls

title: Temporal Zoom
description: Zooms the timeline from years to milliseconds with semantic level changes. Zooming out aggregates; zooming in reveals detail. The timeline adapts its representation to the scale.

demo.title: Demo — Temporal Zoom

title: Annotation Layers
description: Layers annotations on timelines so teams mark what matters. Incidents get markers; handoffs reference times, not descriptions. The timeline becomes shared memory.

demo.title: Demo — Annotation Layers

title: Causality Visualization
description: Shows causal links along the timeline: this caused that. Trace-derived causality turns sequences into explanations; scrubbing follows the chain. It answers 'why', not just 'when'.

demo.title: Demo — Causality Visualization

title: Virtualized Timeline Rendering
description: Renders million-event timelines with virtualization: only visible events exist in the DOM. The scrubber stays smooth at any scale; off-screen events are just numbers. Performance is the enabler.

demo.title: Demo — Virtualized Timeline Rendering

title: Keyboard Timeline Navigation
description: Navigates timelines fully by keyboard: arrows scrub, modifiers jump. Power users never touch the mouse; every action has a key. Accessibility and speed together.

demo.title: Demo — Keyboard Timeline Navigation

title: Clip Export
description: Exports timeline clips: select a range, render it out. The scrubber defines in/out points; export produces the artifact. It closes the loop from exploration to delivery.

demo.title: Demo — Clip Export

title: Collaborative Timelines
description: Shares live timelines where teams scrub together with cursors and voice. Everyone sees the same moment; discussion anchors to time. Remote incident response gains presence.

demo.title: Demo — Collaborative Timelines

title: Timeline Accessibility
description: Makes timelines accessible: text alternatives, keyboard control, reduced motion. Time-based media excludes without care; the accessible timeline includes everyone. It is a requirement.

demo.title: Demo — Timeline Accessibility
